The film compositions of the films and carbon concentration in the film were investigated by inductively coupled plasma spectroscopy and Auger electron spectroscopy depth profiling. For the electrical measurement, MIM capacitors were fabricated using sputtered Pt through a shadow mask as the top electrode. The fabricated MIM capacitors were annealed at 400 8C under an N2 (95%)/O2 (5%) atmosphere. The C–V and J–V characteristics were measured using a Hewlett-Packard 4194 impedance analyzer at 10 kHz and a Hewlett-Packard 4140 picoammeter/voltage source.
